payload.content: TrailCode/Graft MCP in Hermes: pin @nanonets/graft@0.15.0 (0.25.x serves deferred tools; Hermes client lists 0 tools). Server resolves its repo from process cwd, so each server needs a .cmd wrapper that cds to the indexed repo first (quote the path: spaces break args). hermes mcp test showing 6 tools does NOT prove a graph exists; always verify with a live graft_find_code query (empty graph answers no matching nodes). Maps are per-project; Opencode root has no map (per-project graphs under Projects/). Hermes map covers skills/memories/scripts/plugins/cron/hooks/platforms/shared; rebuild after big folder changes.
